name: io.github.iowarp/jarvis-mcp
title: CLIO Jarvis
description: JARVIS-CD MCP server with a compact user pipeline surface and a separate admin entry point.

tools.name: jarvis_create_pipeline
tools.description: Create a JARVIS pipeline for normal agent-driven workflows.

tools.name: jarvis_describe
tools.description: Describe JARVIS packages, one package, a pipeline, or one pipeline step.

tools.name: jarvis_add_step
tools.description: Add a package-backed step to a JARVIS pipeline and optionally configure it.

tools.name: jarvis_edit_step
tools.description: Edit the configuration of a step in a JARVIS pipeline.

tools.name: jarvis_remove_step
tools.description: Remove a step from a JARVIS pipeline without deleting package files.

prompts.name: create_pipeline_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating and deploying a JARVIS pipeline.
